SELECT tick, avg(condition_score) AS cond, avg((NOT power_served)::int) AS unpowered FROM building_monthly GROUP BY tick ORDER BY tick ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT tick, avg(satisfaction) sat, avg(disposable_income) disp FROM citizen_monthly GROUP BY tick ORDER BY tick ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.tick,t.year,t.month, b.balance,b.debt,b.treasury, p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,p.outage_fraction,p.contract_mode, w.capacity,w.demand,w.load_ratio,w.failure_rate, m.population,m.net, l.income_tax_rate,l.property_tax_rate,l.electricity_tariff,l.road_maintenance_budget,l.water_sewer_capex,l.zoning_release FROM ticks t JOIN budget_monthly b USING(tick) JOIN power_monthly p USING(tick) JOIN water_monthly w USING(tick) JOIN migration_monthly m USING(tick) JOIN lever_monthly l USING(tick) WHERE t.tick >= (SELECT max(tick)-5 FROM ticks) ORDER BY t.tick

SELECT t.tick, round(avg(bm.condition_score)::numeric,3) avg_building_derelict, round(avg(rm.wear)::numeric,3) avg_road_wear, round(avg(rm.congestion)::numeric,3) avg_congestion, round(avg(cm.travel_time)::numeric,2) avg_travel, round(avg(cm.uses_transit::int)::numeric,3) transit_share, round(avg(cmm.satisfaction)::numeric,3) satisfaction, round(avg(cmm.employed::int)::numeric,3) employment FROM ticks t LEFT JOIN building_monthly bm USING(tick) LEFT JOIN road_monthly rm USING(tick) LEFT JOIN commute_monthly cm USING(tick) LEFT JOIN citizen_monthly cmm USING(tick) WHERE t.tick >= (SELECT max(tick)-12 FROM ticks) GROUP BY t.tick ORDER BY t.tick

SELECT t.tick, b.income_tax_revenue,b.property_tax_revenue,b.utility_revenue,b.transit_revenue,b.road_spend,b.water_sewer_spend,b.other_spend,b.balance,b.debt,b.treasury, l.* FROM ticks t JOIN budget_monthly b USING(tick) JOIN lever_monthly l USING(tick) WHERE t.tick IN (0,12,24,36,48,60,72,84,96,108,120) ORDER BY t.tick

SELECT l.tick,l.power_contract_mode,p.contract_mode,p.outage_fraction,p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,l.electricity_tariff FROM lever_monthly l JOIN power_monthly p USING(tick) WHERE l.tick>=50 ORDER BY l.tick
SELECT tick,avg(condition_score) AS building_condition,avg(occupancy) AS occupancy FROM building_monthly WHERE tick IN (48,54,60) GROUP BY tick ORDER BY tick
SELECT tick,avg(wear) AS wear,avg(congestion) AS congestion FROM road_monthly WHERE tick IN (48,54,60) GROUP BY tick ORDER BY tick
SELECT tick,avg(satisfaction) AS satisfaction,avg(employed::int) AS employment,avg(disposable_income) AS disposable FROM citizen_monthly WHERE tick IN (48,54,60) GROUP BY tick ORDER BY tick
